query: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name
result: Six tables exist: cards, foreign_data, legalities, rulings, set_translations, sets. Row counts: cards 56822, foreign_data 229186, legalities 427907, sets 551, set_translations 1210, rulings 87769.

query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM foreign_data f JOIN cards c ON f.uuid=c.uuid), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalities l JOIN cards c ON l.uuid=c.uuid), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rulings r JOIN cards c ON r.uuid=c.uuid); SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT uuid) FROM cards;
result: foreign_data joins to cards on uuid for 229170 of 229186 rows; legalities for 427835 of 427907; rulings for 87769 of 87769. cards.uuid is unique: 56822 rows, 56822 distinct values.

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards c JOIN sets s ON c.setCode=s.code; SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT code) FROM sets; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM set_translations st LEFT JOIN sets s ON st.setCode=s.code WHERE s.code IS NULL;
result: All 56822 card printings join to a set through setCode = sets.code; sets.code is unique across 551 sets; no set translation references an unknown set code.

query: SELECT name, setCode FROM cards WHERE name='Ancestor''s Chosen' GROUP BY setCode; SELECT setCode FROM cards WHERE name='Angel of Mercy' GROUP BY setCode;
result: 'Ancestor's Chosen' is printed in 3 sets (10E, JUD, UMA). 'Angel of Mercy' is printed in 14 sets (10E, 8ED, 9ED, DDC, DVD, IMA, INV, JMP, MB1, P02, PS11, PSAL, S99 and others).

query: SELECT setCode FROM cards WHERE name='Angel of Mercy' GROUP BY setCode
result: 14 distinct sets contain a printing named 'Angel of Mercy', confirming that a card name does not determine a single set.

query: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM legalities GROUP BY status
result: Three stored values only: 'Legal' 424958, 'Banned' 2313, 'Restricted' 636. Lowercase spellings are not stored.

query: SELECT format, COUNT(*) FROM legalities GROUP BY format ORDER BY format
result: 15 lowercase format tokens: brawl 7698, commander 55576, duel 55544, future 7698, gladiator 16568, historic 16568, legacy 55576, modern 40774, oldschool 4621, pauper 22784, penny 38159, pioneer 22346, premodern 20721, standard 7698, vintage 55576.

query: SELECT language, COUNT(*) FROM foreign_data GROUP BY language ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM foreign_data WHERE language LIKE '%Brasil%';
result: 16 distinct labels: Japanese 31226, French 29301, German 28891, Italian 28698, Spanish 28639, Portuguese (Brazil) 25641, Chinese Simplified 20106, Russian 15878, Chinese Traditional 11106, Korean 9692, plus 6 rare languages with 1 to 3 rows. 0 rows match the spelled-out spelling 'Brasil'. English is absent as a language value.

query: SELECT language, COUNT(*) FROM set_translations GROUP BY language; SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT setCode) FROM set_translations;
result: Exactly 10 languages appear, each covering the same 121 sets: Chinese Simplified, Chinese Traditional, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Spanish. 1210 translation rows total.

query: SELECT * FROM set_translations WHERE setCode='ARC'
result: Set ARC (Archenemy) carries set translations in all 10 languages, including Korean; the translated name is 'Archenemy' in each of them. This shows set-name translation coverage is independent of whether the set's cards were localized.

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM foreign_data f JOIN cards c ON f.uuid=c.uuid WHERE c.setCode='ARC'; SELECT f.language, COUNT(*) FROM foreign_data f JOIN cards c ON f.uuid=c.uuid WHERE c.setCode='CSP' GROUP BY f.language;
result: Set ARC has 151 card printings but 0 foreign-language records. Set CSP (Coldsnap) has 155 foreign-language records for each of 8 languages (Chinese Simplified, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Spanish) and no Korean records.

query: SELECT c.setCode, f.language FROM foreign_data f JOIN cards c ON f.uuid=c.uuid WHERE c.name='Ancestor''s Chosen' GROUP BY c.setCode, f.language ORDER BY c.setCode; SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FROM cards c JOIN foreign_data f ON c.uuid=f.uuid WHERE c.setCode='10E';
result: Printings of 'Ancestor's Chosen': the 10E printing has 8 foreign languages (Chinese Simplified, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Spanish) and no Korean record; JUD has 6 languages; UMA has only Japanese. The 10E set overall has 363 foreign-language records per language.

query: SELECT code,name,block,mcmName,mtgoCode FROM sets WHERE name LIKE '%Coldsnap%'; SELECT code,name,mcmName FROM sets WHERE mcmName LIKE '%Archenemy%' OR name LIKE '%Archenemy%';
result: Coldsnap matches three sets: CSP 'Coldsnap', CST 'Coldsnap Theme Decks', PCSP 'Coldsnap Promos', all in block Ice Age. Archenemy matches ARC 'Archenemy' (mcmName 'Archenemy'), E01 'Archenemy: Nicol Bolas', and the schemes sets OARC and OE01.

query: SELECT rarity, COUNT(*) FROM cards GROUP BY rarity ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
result: Four lowercase values: common 20745, rare 17626, uncommon 15251, mythic 3200.

query: SELECT borderColor, COUNT(*) FROM cards GROUP BY borderColor ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
result: Five lowercase values: black 49729, white 5017, gold 1244, silver 591, borderless 241.

query: SELECT power, COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE power IS NULL OR power='*' GROUP BY power
result: 30624 rows have NULL power (non-creature cards) and 429 rows have the variable value '*'.

query: SELECT hasContentWarning, COUNT(*) FROM cards GROUP BY hasContentWarning
result: 0 -> 56793 rows, 1 -> 29 rows. The flag is an integer with default 0.

query: SELECT isStorySpotlight, COUNT(*) FROM cards GROUP BY isStorySpotlight
SELECT MIN(edhrecRank), MAX(edhrecRank), SUM(edhrecRank IS NULL) FROM cards; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE edhrecRank=1;
result: Rank range 1 to 20900; 4761 rows have no rank (NULL). 33 card printings hold rank 1.

query: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(mtgoCode IS NOT NULL AND mtgoCode<>'') FROM sets; SELECT code,name,mtgoCode FROM sets LIMIT 3;
result: 160 of 551 sets carry a non-empty mtgoCode. 10E has mtgoCode '10E'; 2ED 'Unlimited Edition' has none.

query: SELECT artist, COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE artist LIKE 'Stephen Dan%' GROUP BY artist; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE artist='Adam Rex';
result: The only stored spelling is 'Stephen Daniele' with 74 card printings; no row matches 'Stephen Daniel'. 'Adam Rex' matches 256 card printings.

query: SELECT name, convertedManaCost, manaCost, setCode FROM cards WHERE name IN ('Serra Angel','Shrine Keeper') LIMIT 6
result: convertedManaCost is a numeric REAL value (Serra Angel 5.0 across its printings) stored alongside the symbolic manaCost string.

query: SELECT originalType, types, subtypes FROM cards WHERE originalType='Summon - Angel' LIMIT 3; SELECT originalType, COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE originalType LIKE 'Summon%' GROUP BY originalType ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 5;
result: Rows with originalType 'Summon - Angel' have types 'Creature' and subtypes 'Angel'. Other summon-style original types include 'Summon - Legend' 116, 'Summon - Wall' 104, 'Summon - Creature' 103, 'Summon - Cleric' 57.

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sets WHERE block='Commander'; SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.code) FROM sets s JOIN set_translations st ON s.code=st.setCode WHERE s.block='Commander' AND st.language='Portuguese (Brazil)';
result: 23 sets carry block 'Commander' (for example C13 through C20, CM1, CM2, CMA, CMD). 7 of them have a Brazilian Portuguese set translation.

query: SELECT * FROM set_translations WHERE setCode='CSP' AND language='Italian'; SELECT * FROM set_translations WHERE translation LIKE '%Hauptset Zehnte%';
result: CSP Italian translation is 'Ondata Glaciale'. 'Hauptset Zehnte Edition' is the German translation of set code 10E.

query: SELECT f.language, f.name, f.text, f.flavorText FROM foreign_data f WHERE f.language='Italian' AND f.name LIKE 'Prescelto%' LIMIT 1
result: The Italian record for 'Ancestor's Chosen' has name 'Prescelto dell'Antenata', translated rules text including reminder text, and flavorText 'La volontà di tutti, eseguita per mano mia.'.

query: SELECT * FROM rulings LIMIT 3; SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FROM cards c JOIN rulings r ON c.uuid=r.uuid WHERE c.artist='Stephen Daniele';
result: Rulings carry a date and a text and reference a card by uuid. 21 distinct card printings by 'Stephen Daniele' have at least one ruling.

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards c JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid=l.uuid WHERE l.format='gladiator' AND l.status='Banned' AND c.rarity='mythic'; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE edhrecRank=1;
result: No percentage column exists anywhere in the schema; the sampled counts (5 printings that are mythic, gladiator and banned; 33 printings at EDHRec rank 1) can only be turned into percentages by dividing two counts over a stated population.
